title: EAU Prostate Cancer: Diagnostic Evaluation
scope: Supports individual PSA risk assessment, shared early-detection decisions, recognising non-cancer causes of raised PSA and staged diagnostic evaluation.

title: EAU Prostate Cancer: Treatment and Active Surveillance
scope: Supports structured active surveillance and reassessment of PSA changes without declaring progression or changing treatment on PSA alone.

title: EAU Non-neurogenic Male LUTS: Diagnostic Evaluation
scope: Supports history, symptom burden, urinalysis, examination, bladder diaries, uroflowmetry and residual urine assessment for male urinary symptoms.

title: EAU Urological Infections: Recurrent Cystitis and Systemic Infection
scope: Supports culture-confirmed recurrent cystitis, tailored stepped prevention, assessment of systemic warning signs and coordinated management of urinary infection.

title: EAU Urolithiasis: Infection, Obstruction and Procedural Precautions
scope: Supports treating infection before definitive stone removal and urgent source-control assessment when urinary infection coexists with obstruction.

title: EAU Urolithiasis: Metabolic Evaluation and Recurrence Prevention
scope: Supports stone analysis, recurrence-risk assessment, specific metabolic evaluation and balanced dietary and fluid measures for stone prevention.

title: EAU Non-muscle-invasive Bladder Cancer: Diagnosis
scope: Supports investigation of haematuria, documentation of bladder findings, histological assessment of papillary lesions or suspected CIS and recognition of specimen staging limitations.

title: EAU Urethral Strictures: Diagnostic Evaluation
scope: Supports assessment of suspected urethral stricture through history, urinary testing, uroflowmetry, residual urine and specialist anatomical evaluation.

title: University Hospitals Plymouth: Managing a Ureteric Stent after Ureteroscopy
scope: Supports recognising common stent symptoms, identifying fever or severe symptoms requiring medical attention and maintaining a planned stent-removal pathway.

title: EAU Urological Trauma: Ureteric Injury Recognition
scope: Supports suspicion and early specialist assessment of possible ureteric injury, recognising that absent haematuria does not exclude it.

title: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist: Implementation Manual
scope: Supports shared checks at sign-in, time-out and sign-out, confirmation of identity and site, specimen labelling and communication of recovery concerns.
